meta.name: conversion-value-mapper
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "set up conversion values so tROAS optimizes profit not orders", "map margin onto my purchase value", "build value rules for lead / phone / signup conversions", or "stop bidding to revenue when I care about profit"; defines and QAs the conversion VALUE model — per-conversion values, margin/net-value adjustment, static-vs-dynamic value rules, proxy values for non-revenue actions, and a value-vs-count sanity check — as a value-model spec plus a pre-launch value QA sheet. Not for whether the tag fires or UTMs are clean — use conversion-signal-qa; not for cross-platform double-count de-dup — use attribution-reconciler; not for scoring R1/R2 — that is a scored veto in ad-account-auditor. 付费广告转化价值建模/利润出价/价值规则QA

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为付费广告设置转化价值，让出价优化利润而非订单量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营付费广告，希望按利润而非收入优化出价。
copy.tagline_en: Set up conversion values for paid ads so bidding optimizes profit, not orders.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run paid ads and want to bid based on profit rather than revenue.

howto.what: 这个技能会帮你定义和检查付费广告的转化价值模型，包括每次转化的价值、利润率调整、静态或动态价值规则、非收入行为的代理价值，以及价值与数量的核对。最终输出一份价值模型说明和价值QA表。
howto.when: 当你需要设置转化价值，让tROAS（目标广告支出回报率）优化利润而非订单数，或者为线索、电话、注册等转化构建价值规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置转化价值，让tROAS优化利润而不是收入。
say.note: 技能会读取你的GA4购买价值和利润率数据。

say.text: 检查我的转化价值模型，确保价值与利润匹配。
say.note: 技能会运行价值-数量核对，发现差距。

howto.what_en: This skill defines and QAs the conversion value model for paid ads: per-conversion values, margin/net-value adjustment, static vs dynamic value rules, proxy values for non-revenue actions, and a value-vs-count sanity check. Outputs a value-model spec and a pre-launch value QA sheet.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to set up conversion values so tROAS optimizes profit not orders, or to build value rules for lead/phone/signup conversions.

say_en.text: Set up conversion values so tROAS optimizes profit, not revenue.
say_en.note: Skill reads your GA4 purchase value and margin data.

say_en.text: Assign proxy values to my lead and phone conversions for max-conversion-value bidding.
say_en.note: Skill derives proxy values from close rate and AOV.

say_en.text: Check my conversion value model to ensure value matches profit.
say_en.note: Skill runs a value-vs-count reconciliation to spot gaps.
